vector_reference: Locally frozen using OpenSSL dgst -md5 -binary twice, then base64; CSB via OpenSSL dgst -sha1 -hmac <synthetic key> -binary then base64. No supplier golden vectors.
assumptions: Business signature uses raw MD5 bytes at both stages, password + exact sorted compact UTF-8 map JSON
CSB scalar-form signing uses public example header fields and epoch milliseconds, no nonce
body.retBody is decoded exactly once to an object containing map
Response weights are integer grams, CNY prices use major currency units; totalFee is selected explicitly
Fuel breakdown inclusion is unknown; no fee is added to totalFee
All records and credentials are invented; no real prices, routes or product codes
